svg.title: BOQ revision after the RFQ was sent
svg.desc: 1. Engineering saves a new revision with a required reason; removed items are marked, not deleted. 2. SCM is notified, the Initial Price drops to needs revalidation, and the KTD is informed without approving again. 3. The vendor panel shows which vendors still hold an older revision. 4. SCM sends the latest BOQ; the letter lists the changes, and vendors who declined to quote are skipped. 5. Revised quotations record the revision they answer, and their evaluation returns to not assessed.
